payload.text: ST0001 WP14, critic-rust's two calls, ruled 2026-11-03 at dc's ask. (A) Highlander: pplr email builds its address map from person.header.emails, the one About reader every command shares, not a second read of each About with the legacy listing's mailto pattern. No golden changes. The four cases where the two readers disagree are recorded in WP14's body for WP13's CHANGELOG: a plain address now tags, mailto:x?subject tags x, a second '- Email:' line no longer tags, a non-UTF-8 About no longer tags. (B) contact log refuses a second --email, exit 1 naming why, with a test red then green; the legacy logged a mix of two messages, and the port's last-wins dropped the first silently. Recorded in WP14's body. The silent skip of an unreadable About (tree.rs:63, and the same pattern across the crate) predates WP14 and is its own item (todo 5).
